title: tp-run-full-design audit tier return
description: Return envelope for audit-class slots (design-audit, plan-audit, impl-audit). Extends the base tier-return via allOf and adds a verdict plus structured findings the orchestrator uses for retry-with-advice and escalation. The certification fields (guard_claims, guards_certified, certifications, uncertified_phrases, certification_base) and the unverified / known-bypass verdicts are optional extensions; envelopes without them validate unchanged. The `verdict: unverified` conditional governs the post-fold envelope (the one the orchestrator branches on): the certification fold strips any model-supplied certification arrays and always leaves a non-empty certifications or uncertified_phrases array when it yields unverified.

guard_claims.description: Auditor-authored guard claims (claim shape only; path[::node] guard; subjects = the repo-relative files under guard, the only files a certifier may perturb — a claim without them certifies unverified).

guards_certified.description: The Guards certified section body (records with [cert:id] tags, or exactly 'No guard claims.' and nothing else).

certifications.description: Fold-written: one entry per certified claim, keyed (file, id).

uncertified_phrases.description: Fold-written: certifying phrases with no matching record, plus a model-asserted verdict.

certification_base.description: Fold-written for traceability: the verdict before the certification join. Never read.
